name: MiniMax
note: Quota only. MiniMax reports one window per model in a list rather than a keyed object, so the window key is the model name. The international endpoint is used; a China-region account should override `quota.endpoint` with api.minimaxi.com in ~/.antarium/harnesses/minimax.json. Model names come back verbatim, so badges/labels are declared for the models MiniMax ships today; an unlisted model still charts, abbreviated from its name.

compatibility.note: Mapping is fixture-verified against the published response shape; the numbers themselves are unconfirmed against a live plan.
